articles.title: Donnie Dunagan, original voice of Disney’s Bambi and triple Purple Heart marine, dies aged 92
articles.summary: Dunagan was six when he voiced the young deer in the classic cartoon, with an assistant director instructing him to pretend his own mother had died

articles.title: 1 in 2 review – compassionate film about dealing with bowel cancer is a personal plea on behalf of the young
articles.summary: David Wilkinson made this warm, generous documentary of his own treatment, and asks why so many much younger people are getting the same diagnosis

articles.title: ‘Sadistic, forbidden pleasure’: why Gone Girl is my feelgood movie
articles.summary: The latest in our ongoing series of writers highlighting their go-to comfort films is a reminder of the dark joys that can be found in David Fincher’s devilish thriller

articles.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon review – Iranian teen refugee paints boldly imaginative self-portrait
articles.summary: Soraya Akhlaghi filmed her perilous flight from Iran and precarious new life over five years on her phone, reassembled here with yearning animations

articles.title: 100 Sunset review – elliptical, elusive drama dreamlike through Toronto’s tight-knit Tibetan community
articles.summary: Kunsang Kyirong’s debut feature fades like a vapour trail in a mood of disorientation and dislocation

articles.title: Robert Pattinson has auditioned for James Bond – and finally the 007 race is interesting | Sian Cain
articles.summary: Hollywood’s weirdest man has entered the fray and the casting decision that has dragged on and on suddenly feels exciting for the first time

articles.title: Pickpockets review – small-budget Australian crime flick steals audience’s heart
articles.summary: DC Fairhurst and Lucy Green’s film could have been a by-the-numbers genre piece. Instead it is fun, frothy and refreshingly different

articles.title: Bluey’s Daley Pearson on how losing his brother inspired his new film: ‘He was the best thing ever to me’
articles.summary: The first live-action film from Pearson’s Ludo Studio follows a man who met an alien as a kid – and becomes obsessed with bringing him back
